instruction_quality.evidence: Project-specific: components, device target, models, structure, security section. build/test/lint are templated Gradle placeholders (TODO until project scaffolded).
instruction_quality.why: Value comes from project-specific facts (exact commands, paths, conventions), not boilerplate.
instruction_quality.consequence: Placeholder commands force trial-and-error until real Gradle commands are verified.
instruction_quality.fix_ref: Update commands once ./gradlew exists; add domain gotchas.

instruction_conciseness.evidence: instruction_audit: 79 lines, ~1041 tokens, no boilerplate, under 300-line limit.

hierarchical_instructions.evidence: Single root AGENTS.md; no subpackages exist yet (no source).
hierarchical_instructions.why: Scoped per-package instruction files give locally-relevant context in large repos.
hierarchical_instructions.consequence: Not relevant until the app grows multiple modules.

cross_agent_bridge.evidence: CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md (single source of truth, no contradictory copy).

repo_map_availability.evidence: repo_map.py: 0 files analyzed (no source yet); no committed map.
repo_map_availability.consequence: Nothing to map until code exists.
repo_map_availability.fix_ref: Generate repo_map once Kotlin sources exist.

semantic_nav_amenability.evidence: Target stack is Kotlin (statically typed, LSP-friendly), but no code/build config yet.
semantic_nav_amenability.why: LSP semantic nav (Serena) needs typed, analyzable code.
semantic_nav_amenability.consequence: Amenability realized once Kotlin sources land.
semantic_nav_amenability.fix_ref: Keep code typed; ensure a Kotlin language server is available.

dependency_structure_clarity.evidence: Clear component boundaries described in the design spec, but no build.gradle / derivable dependency graph yet.
dependency_structure_clarity.why: Derivable dependency graph lets agents reason about blast radius.
dependency_structure_clarity.consequence: No machine-readable structure until Gradle modules exist.
dependency_structure_clarity.fix_ref: Define Gradle modules with explicit dependencies.

readme_overview.evidence: Overview present in AGENTS.md + design spec; no dedicated README.md; setup is TODO.
readme_overview.why: A root README orients agents and humans before deep work.
readme_overview.consequence: Newcomers land without a conventional entry point.
readme_overview.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix navigability_code_intelligence scaffolds a README skeleton.

machine_readable_contracts.evidence: On-device app with no external API boundary; OpenAPI/proto/GraphQL not applicable.
machine_readable_contracts.why: Contracts give unambiguous boundary specs when services exist.
machine_readable_contracts.consequence: Not applicable for an offline, single-app project.
machine_readable_contracts.fix_ref: Add schemas only if a service boundary emerges.

test_suite_present.why: Test feedback is the highest-impact comprehension signal for agents.
test_suite_present.fix_ref: Write unit tests for Chunker, cosine ranking, NormalizedText extraction, PromptBuilder (per spec).

test_commands_documented.evidence: AGENTS.md documents ./gradlew test/connectedAndroidTest, marked TODO until wrapper exists; test_commands.py found no runnable command.
test_commands_documented.why: Agents need discoverable commands to self-verify.
test_commands_documented.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix testing_feedback once the runner exists.

fast_feedback_loop.evidence: Unit tests noted as fast/deterministic; no defined quick-subset command.
fast_feedback_loop.why: A fast subset enables many feedback cycles per task.
fast_feedback_loop.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix testing_feedback documents a quick-subset convention.

feedback_quality.evidence: Kotlin is statically typed (inherent), but no tests or assertion messages exist yet.
feedback_quality.why: Descriptive assertions + type-checking turn failures into actionable signals.

coverage_reasonable.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix testing_feedback scaffolds a coverage config (e.g. JaCoCo).

ci_runs_tests_lint.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml with JDK 17 + Gradle cache; test/lint steps are TODO placeholders (commented).
ci_runs_tests_lint.why: CI is the automated trusted feedback gate.
ci_runs_tests_lint.consequence: Gate inert until commands are uncommented.
ci_runs_tests_lint.fix_ref: Uncomment ./gradlew test/lint once the project builds.

lint_format_automated.evidence: ktlint referenced in pre-commit + CI, but not yet wired into a Gradle build.
lint_format_automated.why: Mechanical style enforcement keeps agent output consistent.
lint_format_automated.consequence: Not runnable until Gradle/ktlint plugin added.

pre_commit_hooks.evidence: .pre-commit-config.yaml with trailing-whitespace, large-file guard, ktlint, detect-secrets.
pre_commit_hooks.why: Hooks shift checks left to commit time.
pre_commit_hooks.consequence: detect-secrets needs a .secrets.baseline; ktlint hook needs Gradle.

governance.why: Review routing + dependency automation keep an agent-active repo healthy.
governance.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix cicd_automation_governance generates CODEOWNERS + Dependabot (gradle ecosystem).

standard_skills.consequence: Workflows live only in ad-hoc prompts.
standard_skills.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix agent_tooling_capabilities scaffolds a SKILL.md skeleton.

bundled_helper_scripts.why: Scripts keep deterministic logic out of context.
bundled_helper_scripts.fix_ref: Add scripts/ within a Skill when one exists.

nav_comprehension_mcp_servers.why: Strongest comprehension levers when wired up.
nav_comprehension_mcp_servers.fix_ref: Wire Serena once Kotlin sources exist (Phase 5 advice).

committed_isolation_config.why: True isolation is the only reliable boundary for autonomous execution.
committed_isolation_config.fix_ref: /agent-ready fix security_sandbox scaffolds a .devcontainer with egress allowlist.

documented_execution_policy.evidence: docs/agent-execution.md (LINCE/devcontainer/OS-sandbox/hosted + safe-to-run list); AGENTS.md security section.

agent_permission_policy.why: Constrains what an agent may do unprompted (CVE-2025-59536 caveat).
agent_permission_policy.fix_ref: Author restrictive deny rules per threat model.

secret_hygiene.evidence: secret_hygiene.py: .gitignore 100% secret coverage, .env.example present (no real values), no committed secrets. No CI secret scanning yet.
secret_hygiene.why: AI commits leak secrets at ~2x baseline.
secret_hygiene.fix_ref: Enable GitHub secret scanning + push protection.

supply_chain_pinning.evidence: No lockfiles / Gradle dependency locking; no Dependabot/Renovate.
supply_chain_pinning.why: Pins the dependency surface CI/agents install.
supply_chain_pinning.fix_ref: Enable Gradle dependency locking + Dependabot (gradle) once deps exist.

injection_hygiene.evidence: Instructions live only in AGENTS.md; docs/spec are descriptive, no instruction-like/executable content.

spec_tasks_dir.evidence: specs/TEMPLATE.md + a real approved design spec in docs/superpowers/specs/.
spec_tasks_dir.why: Spec-driven dev steers agents on what to build.
spec_tasks_dir.consequence: specs/ not yet populated with per-task specs.
spec_tasks_dir.fix_ref: Author delta-scoped specs per change using the template.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: TEMPLATE.md has an acceptance-criteria section; the design spec uses scope/decisions, not explicit checkable criteria.
acceptance_criteria.why: Gives a verifiable definition of done.
acceptance_criteria.consequence: "Done" stays subjective until criteria are written.

issue_pr_templates.why: Standardizes context per unit of work.

adr_decisions.evidence: Design spec has a 'Decisioni prese in brainstorming' log; no formal docs/adr/.
adr_decisions.why: ADRs preserve the why behind choices.

docs_comprehension_signals.evidence: Strong architecture narrative + data-flow diagram in the design spec; no changelog; no code annotations yet.
docs_comprehension_signals.why: Architecture doc + type/docstring coverage aid comprehension.
docs_comprehension_signals.consequence: No changelog; code legibility unmeasured until code exists.
docs_comprehension_signals.fix_ref: Add a CHANGELOG; keep KDoc on public APIs.

instruction_audit.note: CLAUDE.md duplication flag is the symlink to AGENTS.md, not drift
